fact: General Regulation No 64/2023 of 25/04/2023 governs money remittance services in Rwanda, including providers working in partnership with an international remittance service provider under a primary agency agreement.
title: Amabwiriza rusange N° 64/2023 yo ku wa 25/04/2023 agenga serivisi zo kohereza amafaranga (Regulation on Money Remittance Services)
publisher: National Bank of Rwanda (Official Gazette Special of 28/04/2023)
